title: Kickoff notes
caption: Seven pages from one meeting: the project, two people, an API, a policy and an overview.
verdict: The first source creates the wiki: a page for the source, pages for the project, two people and the Billing API, a page for the retention policy, and an overview. Nothing existed before, so every line is new.
lesson: One source fans out into several pages. Each fact is filed where someone will look for it later, not left inside the meeting notes.

quotes: Support exports them by hand from the admin console, about 40 tickets a week.
Build a self-serve export: a customer picks a date range and receives one CSV of their invoices.
anchors: It replaces manual exports by support

quotes: Amara owns the project. Rui owns the customer-facing copy.
Exports run as a nightly batch job, not on demand, so the job can read from the Postgres read replica while traffic is low.
anchors: Runs as a nightly batch job

quotes: Invoice totals come from the Billing API, which the Payments team owns.
Finished export files are kept for 30 days, then deleted.
